notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to give Flumph indestructible.
You have a way to deal damage to Flumph.
description:
Give Flumph indestructible, if needed.
Deal damage to Flumph.
Flumph triggers, causing you and an opponent to draw a card.
Orcish Bowmasters triggers, dealing 1 damage to Flumph and causing you to amass Orcs 1.
Repeat from step 3.
